newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies 14 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies 14 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following 14 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Van Buren School District No 42, Ark., $4.15 million construction bonds.
--Mesa Unified School District No 4, Ariz., $14.75 million school bonds.
--Lake County, Ill., $11 million water and sewer bonds.
--Champlin Economic Development Authority, Minn., $3 million general obligation bonds.
--Las Cruces, N.M., $3.26 million general purpose bonds.
--Berkeley County School District, S.C., $9.3 million school building bonds.
--Harris County Utility District No 4, Texas, $1.97 million waterworks and sewer system bonds.
--Timberlake Improvement District, Texas, $2.18 million taxable GOs.
--Olympia School District No 111, Wash., $23 million GOs.
